scenes.text: Do you keep tapping 'remind me later'?
scenes.say: Do you keep tapping remind me later? Updates fix security holes.

scenes.fact: Many updates fix security problems too.
scenes.say: Many people think updates only add new features. But many updates also fix security problems.

scenes.title: Stay up to date
scenes.say: Three habits. Turn on automatic updates. Restart when your device asks. And update the apps you still use.

scenes.title: Remove apps you don't use
scenes.body: Fewer apps means fewer things to keep updated.
scenes.say: Bonus tip. Remove apps you do not use. Fewer apps means fewer things to keep updated.

scenes.sub: A new tech tip every day
